name: Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro | WHITE | ANC Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds with Adaptive AI & Immersive Sound
description:
Experience premium audio and seamless connectivity with Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro, designed for crystal-clear sound, comfort, and adaptive listening. Featuring Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) powered by AI, these earbuds adjust automatically to your environment for an immersive and uninterrupted listening experience. Perfect for work, workouts, travel, or casual listening.

Key Features
Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation – Automatically adjusts noise reduction for an immersive experience
Crystal-Clear Calls – Dual beamforming microphones capture your voice with clarity
Studio-Quality Sound – Deep bass, balanced mids, and crisp highs for a rich audio experience
Ergonomic Comfort – Lightweight design with multiple ear tips for all-day wear
Touch Controls – Easily manage music, calls, and voice assistants from your earbuds
Seamless Connectivity – Compatible with Samsung devices and other Bluetooth-enabled smartphones
Water-Resistant – Can handle everyday splashes and sweat

Product Details
Product Type: Wireless Earbuds
Target Audience: Men & Women
Connectivity: Bluetooth
Special Features: Adaptive ANC, Touch Controls, Dual Beamforming Mic, Immersive Sound
Color: White

Benefits
Enjoy uninterrupted music and calls
Crystal-clear audio quality for all-day use
Adaptive noise cancellation for focused listening
Comfortable and ergonomic fit
Water-resistant design for daily use
Compatible with a wide range of devices

What’s in the Box
1 × Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro (White)
1 × Charging Case
1 × USB-C Charging Cable
3 × Ear Tip Sets (Small, Medium, Large)
1 × User Manual

Ideal For
Premium wireless audio for work, travel, workouts, or casual listening
Seamless hands-free calls and media control
All-day comfort with an ergonomic, lightweight design
Noise-free music experience in any environment
